method: Confirm the embedded IJG version from the binary copyright and version strings.
Compare decompiled control flow, data structure offsets, and callback-table assignments with the tagged v6b source.
Check the address, function size, xref count, and current IDA name against the inventory before recording a row.
name_policy: Static routines receive libjpeg_<source-file>_<source-name> aliases so repeated upstream callback names remain unique in IDA.
not_claimed: That every source-level IJG helper has a standalone machine function.
That compiler inlining or local build options are absent from the APK.
That the source archive alone proves the runtime image accepts every malformed JPEG input safely.

source.acquisition_note: The official v6b archive was downloaded once into a local pinned checkout for comparison. This report reads only the local IDA inventory.
